outbox_values.name: outbox_values
outbox_values.value: "email_outbox"."locale" IN ('en','nl') AND "email_outbox"."status" IN ('pending','sending','sent','failed','purged') AND "email_outbox"."attempts" >= 0 AND (("email_outbox"."status" = 'purged' AND "email_outbox"."recipient" IS NULL) OR ("email_outbox"."status" <> 'purged' AND "email_outbox"."recipient" IS NOT NULL))

event_values.name: event_values
event_values.value: "events"."capacity" > 0 AND "events"."ends_at" > "events"."starts_at" AND "events"."registration_cutoff" < "events"."starts_at" AND "events"."timezone" = 'Europe/Amsterdam' AND "events"."status" IN ('scheduled','cancelled') AND ("events"."meal_allocation" IS NULL OR ("events"."meal_allocation" >= 0 AND "events"."meal_allocation" <= "events"."capacity"))

identity_or_anonymous.name: identity_or_anonymous
identity_or_anonymous.value: ("registrations"."anonymized_at" IS NULL AND "registrations"."email_normalized" IS NOT NULL AND "registrations"."full_name" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("registrations"."full_name")) > 0) OR ("registrations"."anonymized_at" IS NOT NULL AND "registrations"."email_normalized" IS NULL AND "registrations"."full_name" IS NULL AND "registrations"."comments" IS NULL AND "registrations"."dietary_notes" IS NULL AND "registrations"."dietary_consent_at" IS NULL)

dietary_consent.name: dietary_consent
dietary_consent.value: "registrations"."dietary_notes" IS NULL OR "registrations"."dietary_consent_at" IS NOT NULL

walk_in_values.name: walk_in_values
walk_in_values.value: length(trim("walk_in_guests"."full_name"))>0 AND "walk_in_guests"."status" IN ('confirmed','cancelled','no_show') AND "walk_in_guests"."limits_overridden" IN (0,1) AND ("walk_in_guests"."limits_overridden"=0 OR ("walk_in_guests"."override_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("walk_in_guests"."override_reason"))>0))
